topic.title: Working as a Subject-Matter Expert
topic.shortdesc: Subject-Matter Experts (Reviewers) use to review shared content, add feedback, and suggest changes in a review task. They can also create and own review tasks.

body.p: This section explains the typical workflow for Subject-Matter Experts in .

As a Subject-Matter Expert or Reviewer, you work with review tasks. You can open shared content, read it in context, add comments, suggest edits, and reply to discussions. You can also create your own review tasks.
The Subject-Matter Expert platform user role (license) is designed specifically for this type of user.

section.title: What Subject-Matter Experts Can Do

ul.li: Open review tasks that task owners shared with them.
Read and navigate the documents included in a review.
Reply to comments and take part in discussions.

section.p: Subject-Matter Experts do not have access to project functionality or project roles.

ul.li: Start with Review tasks overview to understand how review tasks work.
If you need to create or manage your own task, continue with Creating review tasks.
For day-to-day review work, see Reviewing content, Commenting and suggesting changes, and Communicating with authors.
When you are ready to start working with review tasks hands on, see the Review Tasks section for instructions on how to use the application.
